verdict.rationale: Feitian FIDO keys are physical authenticators for WebAuthn/U2F, PIV and OTP. A sandbox environment kept separate from production data is a SaaS or API concept that does not apply to this kind of product. The OpenSK development hardware lets users try FIDO authentication with custom firmware, but it is a dev board, not a sandbox isolated from production data, so it does not make the axis applicable.
